overview: The Commission approved several residential parking variances and a handicap sign for a local resident. It also adjusted parking durations on Salem Street to support business turnover while discussing the need for a citywide commercial parking policy.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the previous meeting.

items.title: Handicap Parking Sign: 39 Wellington Road
items.summary: Approved a request for a handicap parking sign due to the resident's difficulty navigating a hill and limited local parking.

items.title: Permit Parking Variance: 545 Main Street
items.summary: Approved a variance allowing a resident of 545 Main Street to park on Smith Street because Main Street is subject to frequent street sweeping and lacks a driveway.

items.title: Permit Parking Variance: 61 Quincy Street
items.summary: Approved a variance for a resident in a non-permitted section of Quincy Street to access permitted spots during snow emergencies.

items.title: Parking Duration Change: 301 Salem Street
items.summary: Approved converting three two-hour parking spaces to 30-minute spaces in front of Eddie's Place and Douglas Bakery to facilitate customer turnover.

items.title: Tabled Business
items.summary: Tabled items regarding 427 High Street and 191 Riverside Avenue because the petitioners were not in attendance.

items.title: Commercial Parking Variance: 11 Walcott Park
items.summary: Placed the matter on file after informing the petitioner that the Commission lacks the legal authority to grant parking variances for commercial vehicles.
